value.rationale: Solves a motivated all-parameter two-sensor placement problem as matching coupling changes from absent to strongly reinforced. Gives all optimal placements, exact counts, a cubic structural transition and an infinite disagreement interval with a sharp 1/(4n) law separating coherence from resistance-only heuristics. Unlike an arbitrary computed instance, the exact parameter phase diagram is useful as a benchmark in stochastic network control.
